findings.rationale: The source states dynamic reactive resources adjust output automatically in real-time over a continuous range within a specified voltage bandwidth in response to grid voltage changes, and operate to maintain a set point voltage or in voltage droop mode. Each clause of the proposition—automatic continuous real-time adjustment within a voltage bandwidth, responsiveness to grid voltage, and the two operating modes—is matched without adding conditions the source lacks. The source's mention of fast response is extra detail, not needed for this proposition.

excerpts.text:
Background 
 
• Dynamic reactive resources  adjust reactive power output automatically in real-time over a c ontinuous 
range within a specified voltage bandwidth in response to grid voltage changes. These resources operate 
to maintain a set point voltage or operate in a voltage droop mode. Many dynamic reactive resources, 
particularly newer ones employing power e lectronics, can respond within electrical cycles using fast -
acting controls. For example, Static Synchronous Compensators ( STATCOMs) have a response time of 
around 50 ms. 
• Static reactive resources have fixed reactive power output at their nominal voltage, and their capability 
varies according to voltage squared.  These devices are switched in or out of service based on system 
conditions. Switching action can be manual or automatic , but this type of  resource provides a fixed 
nominal contribution of reactive power to the grid once connected. 
 
Static reactive resources generally include the following elements: 
• Fixed Shunt Devices: fixed shunt reactive devices include shunt capacitors and reactors. These devices 
have a fixed nominal rating and their reactive power production or consumption is dependent on

Background 
 
• Dynamic reactive resources  adjust reactive power output automatically in real-time over a c ontinuous 
range within a specified voltage bandwidth in response to grid voltage changes. These resources operate 
to maintain a set point voltage or operate in a voltage droop mode. Many dynamic reactive resources, 
particularly newer ones employing power e lectronics, can respond within electrical cycles using fast -
acting controls. For example, Static Synchronous Compensators ( STATCOMs) have a response time of 
around 50 ms. 
• Static reactive resources have fixed reactive power output at their nominal voltage, and their capability 
varies according to voltage squared.  These devices are switched in or out of service based on system 
conditions. Switching action can be manual or automatic , but this type of  resource provides a fixed 
nominal contribution of reactive power to the grid once connected.

actual_question: 按给定NERC资料分别解释动态资源的调节方式及静态资源的输出与投切方式。

initial_answer.text:
动态无功资源在规定电压带宽内随电网电压变化自动实时连续调节输出，可维持电压设定点或按电压下垂模式运行。

静态无功资源在额定电压下输出固定，其能力随电压平方变化，并可按系统条件手动或自动投切。
